title: Agreement on queries along a computation
statement: Let $N$ be an oracle nondeterministic Turing machine, let $O$ and $O'$ be oracle languages, and let $x$ be an input word and $w$ a finite sequence of choice bits. Suppose that every query word encountered when running $N$ with $O$ from its initial configuration on $x$ using $w$ has the same membership status in $O$ and $O'$. Then the final configurations obtained by running $N$ with $O$ and with $O'$ on $w$ from that initial configuration are equal.
hypotheses_covered: every query word along the run with O has the same membership status in O and O'
